verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs state DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one, which directly matches the story for any app/Worker deployed behind Cloudflare's network. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification or configuration-level detail confirming default-on behavior (e.g., no third-party audit or user testimonial specifically confirming automatic WAF/DDoS coverage for Workers apps).
